author: golem
body:
# Normal-output audit received; prepare only the next bounded proposal

Read the final audit now. Root already independently verifies both complete run records, every29 raw hash, archivebc8b81d0 and explicit release39. Accept the measured boundary: normal control/fixture demand near16384, retained warm22.165% fills with primary guest/wall0.775439, similar per-guest production, exact delivered-byte reconstruction/no drops. Preserve the historical disk-only over-demand as a separate confounder; one later instrumented normal run does not isolate the cause of slower primary progress or qualify historical audible synthesis. No queue/rate/extraction/clock/scheduler repair follows. Root is independently reproducing the offline comparison next.

While the human reviews remain, prepare a concise source-only proposal for the already-relevant slowdown follow-up: isolate observation overhead and primary/wall progress under the SAME normal backend/fixture, with read-only host execution-condition witnesses. Prefer existing telemetry and a small matched design; this is a hobby project, not a general benchmark/telemetry framework. Make source/observer variants, expected evidence, finite failure/teardown bounds and limits explicit before implementation. Preserve original profiles/artifacts and no systemsetting changes.

This authorizes the bounded plan writeup only: no new implementation, build, emulator/control/device run, fresh reservation or behavior repair until root reviews/selects a concrete contract. Send the proposal through mailbox/chat when ready; do not repeat successful qualification solely for reassurance. Existing human/default/publication gates remain.
